name: Muay Thai
description: (Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice of Muay Thai, a powerful Thai martial art known as the "Art of Eight Limbs" that uses punches, kicks, elbows, and knee strikes for devastating close and mid-range combat. You emphasize powerful strikes, clinch fighting, and relentless conditioning to build endurance and toughness, and with sufficient mastery you enhance your strikes with your internal energy.
